title: Build metadata: edit extras in dev/pyproject.py, regenerate the root and release pyproject files, then verify uv.lock with uv lock --check
answers: How do I add or change a dependency in an mlflow extra like db or databricks?
Why did my change to pyproject.toml get overwritten or fail CI?
How do I verify the generated pyproject files and lockfile are in sync?
Where is the source of truth for the published package extras?
body:
Path: The published extras for mlflow packages are generated by dev/pyproject.py:build, which writes libs/skinny/pyproject.toml, pyproject.release.toml and pyproject.toml; the extras lists there are not hand-maintained sources of truth.
Rule: Make extra changes in dev/pyproject.py (e.g. the "db" list inside build), then run dev/pyproject.py in a clean checkout so the generated files match, and confirm it produces no further diff. Then run `uv lock --check` so uv.lock agrees; a lock entry from a dev-only group does not add the package to the published extra.
Symptom: A dependency added only to the generated TOML or only to the dev group was absent from the published wheel's metadata, so installs lacked the driver.
Constraints: Verify by building the wheel and checking its METADATA for Requires-Dist under the extra. Only needed when changing published extras, not for dev-only test dependencies.
applies: Changes to published mlflow package extras and their generated pyproject files, plus lock consistency.
says: Installing the package with database extras fails because required drivers are missing.
Manual edits to package dependency configuration files keep getting overwritten by builds.
Ensure published package installation extras include all required database drivers and dependencies.
Keep package dependency extras and lockfiles properly synchronized across builds and releases.
search: Published package extras must be edited directly in dev/pyproject.py:build, which generates pyproject.toml, pyproject.release.toml, and libs/skinny/pyproject.toml. After running dev/pyproject.py on a clean checkout to verify no diff remains, run uv lock --check to ensure uv.lock matches. Changes apply only to published extras rather than dev-only groups, and verification requires building the wheel to inspect Requires-Dist under METADATA.
